title: How a Baby Mama Visit Turned Into Felony Arrest
description:
► One of Everything Bundle [Limited time]

On August 6, 2023, police responded to a report of a person with a firearm in La Crosse, WI. The incident began when a man, who was outside his home, confronted the driver of a suspicious vehicle in the area. The confrontation escalated into an argument, during which the driver pulled out a firearm and said he was not afraid to use it. Police later located the vehicle and conducted a high-risk traffic stop, during which the driver appeared significantly confused about the situation.
